description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Probes target an address in the 169.254/16 Link-Local prefix (RFC 3927 §2.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.1 reserves 169.254/16 for IPv4 Link-Local. A host MUST pick its tentative address from this prefix; targeting any other prefix means the implementation is not actually doing Link-Local autoconfiguration. This case observes the first DUT-emitted Probe and asserts target_proto_ip starts with 169.254.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (the first one)
     - target_proto_ip ∈ 169.254/16   ← key check (the higher 16 bits = 0xA9FE)

[Pass condition]
First DUT Probe's target_proto_ip is inside 169.254.0.0/16.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_target_ip_outside_link_local_prefix — Probe target is outside 169.254/16
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline

verdicts.Fail_target_ip_outside_link_local_prefix: Probe target is outside the 169.254/16 prefix
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
